_comment: YouQwiz English (09/11/2026) — same structure as data/variants.json, in English. The site youqwiz.com is French-only: no call to action points to it; packshots and CTAs push the channel (subscribe, comment your score). {theme} = today's topic, {n} = number of questions, {noun} = bank subject, {weekday} = day. 'strings' = texts used by scripts/generate.mjs, 'tts' = texts used by scripts/tts.mjs.
